# hirepulse

> Eight pay-per-use data tools (Apify Actors) by hirepulse: AliExpress search results, Google Ads by domain, company buying-intent signals, ATS job boards, Google Jobs, keyword search volume, domain SEO overview and YouTube transcripts. Every tool returns clean JSON. All of them run on the Apify Store (https://apify.com/hirepulse). You pay per use and there is no subscription. Higher Apify plans get volume discounts.

## Connect an AI agent (MCP)

- Remote MCP server, one tool: `https://mcp.apify.com?tools=hirepulse/<tool-id>`
- Several tools at once, comma-separated: `https://mcp.apify.com?tools=hirepulse/google-jobs-scraper,hirepulse/ats-job-pulse`
- Authentication: OAuth in the browser, or the header `Authorization: Bearer <APIFY_TOKEN>`.
- Local (stdio): `npx -y @apify/actors-mcp-server --tools hirepulse/<tool-id>`, with `APIFY_TOKEN` in `env`.
- REST API: `POST https://api.apify.com/v2/acts/hirepulse~<tool-id>/run-sync-get-dataset-items?token=<APIFY_TOKEN>`, with the tool's input as a JSON body.

## Tools

- [AliExpress Search Scraper](https://edtool79-collab.github.io/hirepulse-tools/aliexpress-search-api/): `hirepulse/aliexpress-search-scraper`. AliExpress search results for any query; choose currency and ship-to country; 60 products per page. Fields: product_id, title, url, image_url, price, original_price, discount_percent, currency, rating, sold, sold_text, is_sponsored, listed_since, ship_to. It does NOT return the store or seller name, shipping costs or delivery estimates, reviews or stock. Price: $2.50 per 1,000 products. Free Apify plan: 100 products per run.
- [Google Ads Transparency Scraper](https://edtool79-collab.github.io/hirepulse-tools/google-ads-transparency-api/): `hirepulse/google-ads-transparency-scraper`. Every Google ad a company runs, by domain. Fields include advertiser_name, advertiser_id, advertiser_verified, ad_id, format (text/image/video), first and last shown dates, preview image and Transparency Center link. Summary mode returns one row per domain. Has an "only new ads" monitoring mode. Price: $0.005 per domain + $0.0015 per ad. Free plan: 1 domain, up to 5 ads.
- [Company Intent Radar](https://edtool79-collab.github.io/hirepulse-tools/company-intent-signals-api/): `hirepulse/company-intent-radar`. Per company domain: open jobs and new jobs in the last 30 days (Greenhouse, Lever, Ashby, Workable, SmartRecruiters, Recruitee), Google ads running now and total ads, organic traffic and SEO trend, email provider from MX records, a 0-100 intent score and a one-line summary. Price: $0.03 per company report, charged only when the full report was produced. Free plan: hiring and email signals for 5 companies.
- [ATS Job Scraper](https://edtool79-collab.github.io/hirepulse-tools/ats-jobs-api/): `hirepulse/ats-job-pulse`. All open jobs from a company's Greenhouse, Lever, Ashby, Workable, Recruitee or SmartRecruiters board, by domain (for example stripe.com) or board slug. Workday is not supported. Job fields: title, department, location, is_remote, posted_date, salary (where the company publishes it), detected_technologies, apply_url. A company summary row adds total_active_jobs, remote_jobs, new_jobs, closed_jobs, jobs_by_department, top_locations and top_technologies. Price: see the Apify Store page.
- [Google Jobs Scraper](https://edtool79-collab.github.io/hirepulse-tools/google-jobs-api/): `hirepulse/google-jobs-scraper`. Google Jobs results for any search, in 90+ countries, for a whole country or one city with a radius. Fields: title, company, location, salary text plus salary_min, salary_max, salary_currency and salary_period when shown, contract_type, posted_at, posted_ago, source, apply_url. Price: $0.005 per search that returns jobs + $0.001 per job.
- [Keyword Search Volume](https://edtool79-collab.github.io/hirepulse-tools/keyword-search-volume-api/): `hirepulse/keyword-search-volume`. Google monthly search volume, CPC, competition and keyword ideas. Fields include keyword, search_volume, cpc_usd, competition, competition_level, keyword_difficulty, search_intent and trend_monthly_pct/trend_quarterly_pct/trend_yearly_pct. Price: $0.03 per lookup + $0.005 per keyword result. Free plan: real volume, CPC and difficulty for the first 3 keywords of each run (the free preview depends on availability and can be paused).
- [Domain SEO Overview](https://edtool79-collab.github.io/hirepulse-tools/domain-seo-overview-api/): `hirepulse/domain-seo-overview`. Estimated organic traffic, ranking keywords, traffic value and competitor domains for any domain. Overview fields include organic_traffic_estimate, organic_keywords, organic_traffic_value_usd and keywords_top_3/10/20. Ranked-keyword rows: keyword, position, search_volume, traffic_estimate, url. Price: see the Apify Store page.
- [YouTube Transcript Scraper](https://edtool79-collab.github.io/hirepulse-tools/youtube-transcript-api/): `hirepulse/youtube-transcript-scraper`. Transcripts of YouTube videos in bulk, with timestamps. Fields: video_id, url, title, channel, duration_seconds, language, is_auto_generated, transcript, word_count, segments. Free plan: the first 3 videos of each run. Price: see the Apify Store page.
